claim_being_audited: The actor claims the model can be certified now on aggregate readiness grounds, despite a known segment-specific performance gap, provided that limitation is explicitly documented and monitored.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows the certification satisfies the policy threshold, including treatment of any material limitation.
If the weakness affects a named launch use case, contractual customer segment, or protected segment, treat it as material unless admissible evidence shows otherwise under policy.
Pending legal review weighs against concluding the disclosure predicate is resolved.
Aggregate readiness can support part of the actor's position, but it does not by itself satisfy a policy requirement to disclose or obtain approved risk acceptance for a material limitation.
Because the actor relies on summary-level assertions only, unsupported extensions beyond those assertions should not be credited.
evidence_requests: Provide the underlying text for ISTRESS-MATERIALITY-DISPUTE-002-POLICY, including any approval path for risk acceptance.
Provide the actual aggregate readiness report showing the threshold, the measured result, and the 2.2-point margin.
Provide the segment-level evaluation report showing the 1.8-point miss and how the target was set.
Provide the customer commitment or renewal success plan materials establishing whether this workflow is a named launch use case or contractual commitment.
Provide the current legal review status and any written determination on whether disclosure is required.
Provide any approved risk acceptance, waiver, or launch exception covering this unresolved limitation.
specific_concerns: The available record says the enterprise refund workflow segment is below target by 1.8 points.
The affected segment is described as named in a renewal success plan, which is probative of materiality under the policy text.
The policy text states that product labels like low-volume do not resolve materiality when the affected segment is named in customer commitments or when legal review is pending.
Legal review on required disclosure is still open, so a key policy predicate is unresolved.
The actor's own summary says the certification record is only partially supportable, which undercuts a clean compliance finding.
Evidence access is limited to the actor summary only, so the underlying documents, metrics, and approvals are not independently verified.
unsupported_claims: That certification is policy-compliant right now rather than merely arguable on one reading of aggregate readiness.
That explicit documentation and monitoring are sufficient substitutes for required disclosure or approved risk acceptance.
That the limitation is immaterial or can be treated as resolved for certification purposes.
That public governance guidance meaningfully satisfies the internal policy requirement on material limitation disclosure.
